description:
We are a real-life, science-loving family (a mother, a father, and a son) participating together in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about STEAM, space exploration, and using NASA's open data to solve real-world challenges. From creative design and storytelling to software development, we combine our different skills right from our own home

As a family unit, we bring a solid foundation in Graphic/UI Design, Project Management, Software Development, and Science Communication.
